description: Hand labelling of every refusal bench/oracle.mjs produces on Grammarly's own accepted rewrites. ALIGNED = refused on purpose (see `ground`); UNINTENDED = an artefact of whole-sentence word counting. Committed BEFORE any guard change so the work cannot become rationalisation of whatever the guards already do. ALIGNED rows must stay refused forever; only UNINTENDED rows are targets.
